review_scope: Correct the seven-character high-resolution art-direction board per owner defect report, then assess every character and roster harmony. This board is not a pixel sprite sheet and cannot prove palette conversion, sprite cutout, animation, integration, or ROM behavior.

global_defects: contour thickness/continuity differs across figures and equipment
loose marks and rough edge artifacts appear near feet and crops
weapon highlights do not consistently share the body's palette grouping and light direction
pixel-art cleanliness was described, but the supplied board is a high-resolution illustration and contains no SMS pixel grid to audit

characters.name: Golden Axe Warrior

references.role: owner-established costume and character color family

observed_defects: eyes slightly blurred/asymmetric
sword grip and thumb unclear
round shield appears rigidly attached without a readable grip/strap
small contour artifacts at cape tips and below scabbard
revision_notes: retained young, lean warrior, horned helmet, blue fur cape and approved color family
redrew eye alignment, sword-hand grip and shield/wrist attachment; cleaned cape and scabbard edge in the review candidate

canonical_identity_and_costume.note: Compare helmet, blue fur mantle, shield, sword and silhouette with approved source.

face_eyes_and_mask.note: Confirm both eyes are sharp, aligned and readable at normal viewing size.

hand_anatomy_and_handedness.note: Confirm the sword hand has a clear thumb and plausible finger count.

hand_to_weapon_continuity.note: Trace palm through hilt and guard into the blade without a gap.

joint_alignment.note: Confirm both wrists, elbows, knees and ankles follow the pose.

equipment_attachment_and_perspective.note: Confirm the round shield has a readable left-forearm grip or strap.

silhouette_and_body_proportion.note: Compare youthful lean proportions and relative roster scale.

foot_ground_clearance.note: Check both boots and weapon tips against the common ground line.

outline_and_cutout_cleanliness.note: Inspect cape tips and scabbard edges for detached marks or broken contour.

palette_material_and_lighting.note: Check material grouping and consistent light; exact SMS palette remains unvalidated.

shared_roster_rendering_harmony.note: Compare outline weight, finish and scale with all six other figures.

owner_approval.scope: owner visual approval of this revised art-direction board only; no sprite sheet, SMS palette, integration, or ROM approval

validation_limits: The checklist gate validates axis coverage, notes, statuses and hashes only; humans judge drawing quality.
This RGB concept illustration is not indexed SMS art, has no animation frames, is not integrated into res, and has no ROM binding.
Actual pixel sprite sheets must receive a separate native-size and nearest-neighbor review plus palette, cutout, animation and roster gates.
